nom: OLEHENRIKSEN B5 Boost Hydrating Solid Foaming Gentle Cleanser

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly report the cleanser leaves their face smooth and hydrated rather than tight, though one couple with dry skin found it felt greasy, barely lathered, and did not clean or remove makeup well for them.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one prone to buildup around the nose and forehead, report it cleanses thoroughly without over-drying and without triggering breakouts.
segments.combination: The reviewer with combination skin that turns dry at times reports her skin barrier felt more hydrated after switching to this cleanser, and she needed less moisturizer afterward.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin report no irritation or breakouts even with regular use, though one reviewer with dry, acne-prone, sensitive skin who loved it at first started breaking out badly after about ten days.

concerns.aging: The one reviewer using it for enlarged pores, dullness and early signs of aging reports her skin looked more hydrated, firmer and healthier with consistent use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe the cleanser as leaving skin feeling soft and hydrated rather than tight or stripped, a point repeated across reviewers with dry, oily and sensitive skin alike.
concerns.redness: Reviewers who mention redness report it subtly reduced over a few weeks of use, with one crediting the improvement to the cleanser restoring her skin's barrier.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers report the cleanser leaves their skin barrier feeling stronger and more hydrated, with a couple of them needing less moisturizer afterward.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin report no new breakouts and even a soothing effect, but one reviewer who loved the cleanser at first started breaking out badly after about ten days of use, though she herself was unsure whether her cycle was the cause.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report it removes excess oil and buildup without over-drying their skin or triggering breakouts.

aspects.libelle: Light scent, but off-putting to a few
Barely lathers for some, more of an emulsion
Can sting or irritate if it reaches the eyes
Small amount goes a long way
Jar risks water contamination, less shower-friendly

extraits.titre: Loved it until it broke me out but that could be other cause
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I liked this product at first but after using it a few times (~10 days) I started to breakout really badly. This could be because of my time of the month but I will continue to use this and update if my feelings change. I loved the texture and it did make my skin feel SO clean so it's bummer that it broke me out. Wrote before breakouts: I LOVE this cleanser. I was not expecting to love this as much as I do, I thought it would be ok but I was so wrong. This foams up SO well and only takes a small amount of product (I'm talking a dime size amount for your whole face) and water. No weird texture or feeling gritty - it's very smooth when applied/used. The packaging says to do this on damp skin which I agree with since it foams up quicker that way. Does not leave skin feeling tight at all, makes me look and feel bright/clean. This does have a slight soapy scent but it is not bad and you don't notice it out of the jar, only in the jar. The product is also huge - you need such a small amount this is going to last me a very long time. Skin type: acne prone, dry skin, sensitive

I was excited to try the OleHenriksen B5 Boost Solid Foaming Cleanser to help improve the appearance of my enlarged pores, dull skin, and early signs of aging. I've been using it every morning and evening to cleanse my skin and remove makeup. The formula is unique and very easy to use. I scoop out a small amount, add a little water, let it sit for a few seconds, and it transforms into a rich, creamy foam. I gently massage it onto my face before rinsing thoroughly. It cleanses effectively without feeling harsh or stripping my skin. I love the luxurious texture, and I really appreciate that it's fragrance-free, making it gentle on my skin. After using this cleanser consistently, my skin feels soft, smooth, and refreshed. My complexion looks brighter and more radiant, and I've noticed my skin appears more hydrated, firmer, and healthier. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cleanser really is a very solid gel; I hadn't ever used or even seen one like this before. It even comes with an adorable little spatula to scoop it out! But as long as I follow the directions and wet my face first, it does foam up nicely and works great as a cleanser. It has a scent that's not my favorite, but it's light and inoffensive to me; it just smells like berries. And after using it consistently for a few weeks, it's subtly but noticeably decreased redness on my face and made my skin look a little healthier, smoother, and less dull. It's on the pricey side, but it seems like it'll last several months, and it's made enough of a difference that I plan to continue using it!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] After using Ole Henriksen B5 boost solid foaming facial cleanser I noticed my skin barrier was more hydrated. I have combo skin but at times I can be dry. After washing my face with it I noticed a huge difference. My old face wash was an oil to foam cleanser and would leave me dry and needing to apply moisturizer right away. Ole henriksen did not do that. In fact, I applied less moisturizer after!

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This product is absolutely amazing. I love they way it works, and little bit goes a long way. It just melts into my skin and gently washes away the dirt. There is no drying out the skin or irritation, its amazing how gentle this product is . The cleanser has helped with my skin redness, by restoring the skin's barrier.its kinda unscented. I absolutely love it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cleanser was really good. I have oily skin and often get build up around my nose and forehead. This cleanser after foaming in my hand did amazingly well to cleanse my skin without drying it out. It didn't have much of a scent. Not that I really care for it, and I haven't had any breakouts while using this cleanser consistently.
